root_output_channels: commentary/final (no delivered-message ID or post-render/playback completion callback returned)

exact_missing_edge.before_presentation: prepare(identity), persist token and exact report identity associated with channel presentation
exact_missing_edge.chat: confirmed delivery of that report to the intended user -> stable message event/reference + token -> Caller.confirm(outcome=chat_delivered)
exact_missing_edge.voice: completed playback of that report, not synthesis/stream completion -> stable playback event/reference + token -> Caller.confirm(outcome=voice_playback_completed)
exact_missing_edge.explicit_handled: actual user handled acknowledgement -> stable source-event reference + token -> Caller.confirm(outcome=user_handled)

metadata_refresh: separate supported owner setup; not performed
